identity.question: Will a 8.5+ earthquake occur worldwide by October 31?
identity.literal: Preferred magnitude >=8.5; origin time from market creation through Oct31 2026 23:59:59 ET; only USGS data. Revisions considered through the end of the third calendar day after Oct31, with possible extension up to a week if a qualifying event has not appeared.
